value.narrative: Adil Karrouchy: fed the ball into the penalty area for Iajour. Mouhcine Iajour: finished with his left foot into the far corner past keeper Tamati Williams.

goals.notes: OFC and MyJoyOnline both: Karrouchy played the ball into the box, Iajour left foot into far corner past Williams. Minute 39 from OFC (also AP via The National); MyJoyOnline gives no minute. FOX/RNZ mention a through ball without naming the passer; not used.
